scenes.say: Sorry, prices went up again. Stop saying that.
Saying sorry tells guests the price is a mistake. Saying what it buys tells them it's worth it.
The flat white went from four fifty to four eighty. You don't owe anyone an apology for paying your staff and your rent.

props.caption: Prices go up. *That's okay.*
props.note: staff, rent and milk all *went up too*

scenes.say: So say it once, say it kindly, and stand behind it. Agree? Tell me in the comments.
